summary: In web/src/bridge.ts I added exported startShellStore() right after storeOfGlobal(), returning storeOfGlobal() with a doc comment explaining it makes the dashboard's store at start so it hears the shell's change events from app load. I called it once at module level directly after its definition. I also updated the doc comments of shellStore and useShell to say the store is now made at start (startShellStore) rather than on the first useShell() call. No other behavior changed. All checks pass: pnpm --dir web test (586 tests, 25 files), pnpm --dir web exec tsc -b, and pnpm --dir web lint each exit 0.
concerns: startShellStore() runs at module import, so in a browser with no shell global it creates and keeps a null store early; harmless but worth a glance.
Tests import bridge with vi.resetModules(), so the fresh module's module-level call is what the new test exercises.
